hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-light text-[#0F1A14]

spacing_and_layout.card_style: bg-white border border-[#E2E5DF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] transition-shadow duration-300
spacing_and_layout.hero_grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12 items-center

components_strategy.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with 1px border-b border-black/5. Sticky top with z-50.
components_strategy.buttons: Flat, modern (rounded-md). Primary uses Deep Forest Green (#1A4331) with pure white text. Use slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) on hover.
components_strategy.product_cards: Minimalist layout. Image takes up 75% of height, wrapped in a light gray/sage background for contrast. Details below left-aligned. No visible borders unless hovered.
components_strategy.filters: Sticky sidebar on desktop, horizontal scroll on mobile. Pill-shaped filter tags with muted backgrounds.
components_strategy.cart_drawer: Right-side fixed drawer. Clean list of items, generous spacing. Prominent checkout button with MercadoPago branding.
components_strategy.reprocann_form: Shadcn form heavily customized. Use generous padding (p-8). Large touch targets, clear file upload zone with dashed border and sage background.
components_strategy.admin_panel: Swiss layout. Dense grids/tables for orders and products. Muted borders, no heavy shadows. Functional clarity over aesthetics.

motion.page_load: Framer Motion: fade-in and slide-up (y: 20 -> 0) with slight stagger (0.1s) for grid items.
motion.drawer: Slide in from right, ease-in-out, duration 0.3s.

media.mercadopago_logo_svg_instruction: Use Lucide icons or a standard text 'Pagar con Mercado Pago' with a #009EE3 background to symbolize the integration.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on #1A4331 passes AA minimum (it does).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'add-to-cart-button', 'reprocann-submit', 'mp-checkout').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI using React and JS (.js/.jsx files, NO TypeScript).
Use Tailwind CSS for styling. Implement the custom color palette (#1A4331 primary, #F8F9F7 background) directly in tailwind.config.js or via arbitrary values.
Import 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.html.
DO NOT USE INTER, ROBOTO, or standard system fonts.
CRITICAL RULE: NO SEMILLAS (seeds) in the catalog. Only list equipment: fertilizers, substrates, lights, pots, accessories, pest control, and tools.
The aesthetic must be PREMIUM and MODERN. Avoid reggae/rasta colors, avoid cartoon marijuana leaves. Think 'high-end botanical laboratory'.
Implement the REPROCANN form as a structured multipart form or clean single-page form with file upload.
Admin panel must have CRUD for products and list of orders.
Include legal info for Argentina in the Footer (e.g., 'Venta exclusiva para mayores de 18 años. Cultivo responsable.').
